vibe: Bloomberg Terminal meets modern fintech (dYdX, Hyperliquid). Confident, professional, high-density data UI.

headings.instruction: Use Cabinet Grotesk for main page/section headings to provide an unexpected, sharp display feel.

body.instruction: Use IBM Plex Sans for general UI text, labels, and descriptions.

monospace.instruction: CRITICAL: Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for all numbers, prices, P&L, dates, tabular data, and ticker symbols (e.g., BTCUSD).

layout_and_spacing.density: High density, compact spacing for data. Parent containers use p-6.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Sharp edges. Use `rounded-none` or max `rounded-sm`. Emphasize 1px solid borders over shadows.
layout_and_spacing.surface_treatment: Grid Borders (Technical Look) - prefer `border-collapse` style layouts. Minimize floating cards, prefer docked panels separated by 1px borders.

buttons.style: Flat, sharp corners, high-contrast text. No heavy shadows.
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1F1F1F] text-white hover:border-[#333333] rounded-none

cards.style: Flat surface (#0A0A0A), 1px subtle border (#1F1F1F), no drop shadow. Do not overuse standard Shadcn Card; strip its padding if needed for data tables.

tables.style: Dense tabular layout. JetBrains Mono for all data cells. Subtle row highlight on hover (#121212). Align numbers to the right.

charts.style: Transparent backgrounds. Use #00FF41 for uptrends/equity curve, #FF3B30 for downtrends. Faint 5% opacity grid lines.

navigation.style: Stark, functional left sidebar or top bar. Active states marked with a 2px border of #00FF41.

motion.philosophy: Minimal and instant. Traders value speed over decorative motion.
motion.hover_states: Instant color swaps or fast opacity changes. No bouncy transforms.

icons.style: Regular or Light weight. Keep them sharp and professional.

images.description: Trading terminal data background for login/auth page. Apply a heavy black overlay (bg-black/80) to ensure form visibility.
Abstract dark wire mesh pattern. Can be used as a subtle texture in the sidebar footer or behind the backtest summary.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are working with .js / .jsx files, NOT .tsx. Adjust your syntax accordingly.
Ensure all interactive elements and key information displays have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='live-price-btc', data-testid='risk-level-high').
Prioritize data density. Do not waste space with huge paddings inside data tables or control panels.
Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for numerical data, prices, risk percentages, and tickers.
Apply Archetype 4 rules: monochrome base with bright terminal green/amber for accents/status only. Avoid 'muddy' or generic soft UI.
Do NOT use card components everywhere. Prefer cardless rectangular sections separated by 1px borders (Grid Borders style).
Use Phosphor Icons for a clean, dense dashboard look.
Never use purple, teal, or soft glassmorphism. This is a serious financial tool.
